reviews.comment: There were no online resources for this course. We did not use a textbook and the only notes you get are the ones you took during lecture. The entire course was graded via 3,10 question exams. This was one of my favorite courses. I ended up loving the content. If you do not love the content, you will not do well if you take this course with Burch.
Awful. Only 3 tests and his lectures are just rants about unrelated information. Does not use canvas or email.

Burch is awesome; look at his info w/ the school. Lots of experience and lots of stories to tell, which he will. The material isn't easy, but go to his office hours and talk to him, ask for help. Ask for a retake if you need; he'll most likely give it. I went to every class and loved it. He doesn't do tech though; you've got to meet him in person.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As long as you go to his lectures, you will be fine. He is very understanding and let's you make up any test and is more than willing to help you on questions. He let's you know what will be on his exams and tries his best to make them easy in order to help you get a 100.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This man literally saved my life. If he doesn't like you, you're probably the problem. He is the most caring and understanding professor you will ever have if you just talk to him.

Professor Burch was awesome. There is no homework; you are graded based off three tests. Burch is very clear and tells you outright what will be on the test. If you show up to class, you will learn what you need to know. He definitely wants you to succeed. Reach out to him, and he will help you. Let the whole class retake a test during class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class is HARD. However, Dr. Burch is one of those rare professors who leaves lasting impacts on his students and truly cares about their wellbeing, success, and understanding of the topic. You HAVE to put in the work and you HAVE to go see him to talk through the difficulties, and in doing this, you will NOT sink. 1 of the best profs I've had.

The whole class is graded by 3 tests and nothing else. Super old school and just talks a lot not even about the subject at hand. If you had to quarantine during this class you can kiss passing this class goodbye. Only way to talk to him is over the phone. Don't take an incomplete or they will never tell you what to do about it next semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Burch is old school and if you don't agree with him, you're wrong. Spent most of lectures berating our generation and talking about how great his Russian students had been. Only teaches one way and if you don't understand it, good luck. He views you as a lost cause. Grade is based on three exams and nothing else. Take anyone else if you can.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's the most caring professor I know. You have to be respectful, he is old school so he tends to write down stuff on the board so make sure you bring a notebook to take notes. He always helps you during office hours so if you need help, go to him, he's very nice about giving extra help.

He tells long stories for a lot of class, but he is very interesting and the material is interesting too. His standards for writing essays, however, are a true mystery. He will make you re-write papers until you get the grade you want. That's both good and bad. He genuinely tries to help, but again, very very old school.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Burch is incredible!!! He tells good stories, and knows his students by name. It's true that he lectures using only a white board and dry erase marker, but it works just fine for a math-like course. He gives you old exams to help you study, and they are almost identical to the actual exams. If you complete the old exams, you'll do great!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Burch is the most caring professor you will probably ever have. His life experience is insane and he is so smart. If you don't understand the material, the class will kick your butt, so go to office hours where he is extremely helpful and accessible. Sit at the front of class.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE IF YOUR LIFE DEPENDS ON IT. 3 tests determine your grade and they are only 10 questions each. Its extremely hard and all he talks about is moral superiority.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I have so much respect for this professor. Yes, he is old school and the class is hard. But he is the most caring professor I have ever met. He is always willing to meet with you to help you with class material or even to help you with personal problems. He mentors many students. This class will be a challenge with any professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Very old school prof but he's SO SMART. You do have to go to class, pay attention, and take notes but this class is so fulfilling and rewarding. I'm super bad at math and didn't know anything about logic before taking this class but it ended up being my favorite class ever. Highly recommend if you're willing to put in some effort!

Burch does not like to try to explain concepts or give homework for practice, but rather accuse his students of doing poorly due to substance abuse and the decline of the American education system. He disappears during office hours, goes on rants for 30/50 min of the class, has HORRIBLE handwriting (practically illegible) and is overall awful.

He only gives 3 exams that make up your entire grade with NO homework. He says that he's accessible during office hours, but tends to leave and disappear and leaves you alone. If you don't understand something he tries to blame you and can't explain it differently.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very knowledgeable prof, extremely hard to learn from though. Do not recommend taking if you are unsure or have no prior knowledge in logic!!! He does not understand how to explain any questions!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Robert Burch is OLD SCHOOL. He designed the logic course for A&M. Only uses the white board, no ppts, no ecampus, no email. No assigned HW or quizzes. Just free answer exams ( 10-15 questions). You have to go to class to understand. He seems intimidating but really is so kind & caring. Always willing to help outside of class & wants you to do well
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring
